domain: M&A Virtual Data Room & Confidential Document Room
title: Project Falcon $2.4B Cross-Border Acquisition Data Room
executive_summary: SecureVault Enterprise will host the confidential data room for Project Falcon, a $2.4B cross-border acquisition involving 15,000 external advisors and bidders. The 9-month engagement requires zero-knowledge security, forensic tracking, and regulator-ready auditability for SEC and FINRA review.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text: Our SecureVault Enterprise platform guarantees zero-knowledge encryption with customer-held keys for Project Falcon, supporting 15,000 concurrent deal participants across 40 global deal rooms with sub-second document preview in under 800ms. We include dynamic forensic watermarking on every page view and download, 99.99% uptime SLA with zero scheduled downtime, and unlimited Q&A workflow automation with AI redaction at no extra cost. All activity is captured in a tamper-proof blockchain-anchored audit trail with real-time SEC-compliant export, and we promise instant revocation of access in under 5 seconds globally. Deployment is completed in 48 hours with 24/7 white-glove support, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified infrastructure, and guaranteed compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and FINRA retention rules for 7 years.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text: The system implements zero-knowledge encryption with customer-held keys via AWS KMS Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) using AES-256-GCM, with TLS 1.3 in transit and per-document keys rotated every 90 days. The platform supports up to 2,000 concurrent users per deal room with document preview p95 latency of 2.4 seconds for files under 50MB, and dynamic forensic watermarking is applied only to PDF downloads, not to in-browser HTML5 preview. Availability is targeted at 99.9% excluding the scheduled maintenance window every Sunday 02:00-04:00 UTC during which rooms are read-only, and access revocation propagates on a best-effort basis across edge caches with typical convergence in 15-60 minutes. Audit logs are hash-chained locally with hourly anchoring to Ethereum, retained for 1 year by default with export via CSV API, and Q&A is limited to 5,000 threads per room with no automated AI redaction module in this release.

commitments.proposal_quote: 99.99% uptime SLA with zero scheduled downtime
commitments.spec_quote: scheduled maintenance window every Sunday 02:00-04:00 UTC
commitments.explanation: Proposal promises zero scheduled downtime at 99.99%, while spec mandates a weekly 2-hour Sunday read-only maintenance window and only targets 99.9% excluding that window.

commitments.claim: Unlimited Q&A workflow automation with AI redaction at no extra cost
commitments.proposal_quote: unlimited Q&A workflow automation with AI redaction at no extra cost
commitments.explanation: Spec caps Q&A at 5,000 threads per room and explicitly states no automated AI redaction module exists in this release, providing no support for unlimited automation or included cost.

commitments.claim: Instant global access revocation in under 5 seconds
commitments.proposal_quote: instant revocation of access in under 5 seconds globally
commitments.spec_quote: access revocation propagates on a best-effort basis across edge caches
commitments.explanation: Spec uses best-effort language with 15-60 minute convergence, leaving undefined whether 5-second revocation applies to origin only or edge caches, creating critical uncertainty for leak containment.

commitments.spec_quote: zero-knowledge encryption with customer-held keys via AWS KMS Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)
commitments.explanation: Spec confirms the zero-knowledge model with customer-held BYOK keys, AES-256-GCM and 90-day rotation, directly supporting the proposal's encryption claim.
